literal_meaning: উকুন (lice) বাছা (picking or selecting young ones)
figurative_meaning_en: To engage in useless or idle work
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে সারাদিন উকুন বাছা করে, কোনো কাজ করে না।
এই অবস্থায় উকুন বাছা ছাড়া আর কী করা যায়?
example_sentences_in_english: He spends the whole day picking lice, doing nothing productive.
In this situation, what else can one do but engage in idle pursuits?
history: Refers to the traditional rural practice of meticulously picking lice from hair, often by women or elders, symbolizing time-wasting and trivial activities in Bengali folk life.
note: The idiom draws from everyday hygiene practices in pre-modern Bengali society, highlighting cultural norms around idleness.
